Small controlled recoil, no huge head or body bob, boots remain on same baseline; no motion blur, sparks, attack effects, red marking lines, labels or text. EXACT 4x4 evenly spaced grid, each sprite entirely in its own square cell with safe margins; identical character scale and fixed hip horizontal root, fixed floor across each row. True transparent alpha outside characters, no white matte, glow or shadow. Crisp native pixel art matching reference rather than painterly.
